_meta.anthropic/searchHint: wait until screen settles idle stable stops changing animation transition rendered ready before screenshot

description:
Block until the screen has rendered content and stopped changing, or the timeout elapses. It polls the same element tree as `describe`.
Use when a launch or navigation must finish rendering before a screenshot or tap.
Returns { settled, waitedMs, polls, note? }. If the screen never goes still before timeoutMs, it returns settled=false instead of failing.

minStableMs.description: The screen must hold the same content for at least this long to count as settled (default 250). Range: 0 to 10000.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to re-read the tree (default 200). Range: 50 to 5000.

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for the screen to settle before giving up (default 3000). Maximum: 120000. Must be greater than 0.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID, Android serial, or Chromium id).

name: await-screen-idle
